SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_2) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM KII_PO_KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PODOWN' AND NVL(TRIM(KEY_10),'T') = 'T' GROUP BY KEY_1,KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KOLN' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(CURRENCY_CODE,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(ITEM_AMT,0) AS ITEM_AMT, NVL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(PURCHASER_USER_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, NVL(KEY_3,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, NVL(REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, NVL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, NVL(PRE_GR_FLAG,' ') AS DOC_TYPE, NVL(REMARK1,' ') AS REMARK, NVL(REMARK2,' ') AS REMARK2, NVL(REF_IF_NO,' ') AS REF_IF_NO FROM KII_PO_KEP_PODETAIL_V, KII_PO_KEPTRXL WHERE KEY_1 = LEGACY_PO_NO(+) AND KEY_2 = LEGACY_PO_SEQ(+) AND KEY_3 = DECODE(KEY_3,' ',' ',LEGACY_PR_NO(+)) AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND DOC_NAME = 'PODOWN' AND NVL(TRIM(KEY_10),'T') = 'T' ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2,KEY_3
UPDATE KII_PO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'D', KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND DOC_NAME = 'PODOWN' AND NVL(TRIM(KEY_10),'T') = 'T'
